arguments.summary: Review found no claim-specific contradiction requiring an objection. The draft preserves the main independent-risk constraints: completed-close framing, non-predictive technical comparisons, explicitly hypothetical valuation grids, and unquantified policy/supply channels.
assumptions: Review was limited to the Director draft and supplied evidence; no new source inspection or calculation was performed.
Scenario grids remain conditional sensitivities rather than forecasts, fair values, or probability-weighted outcomes.
arguments.counter_thesis: The conditional NVDA 63-session preference could remain reasonable if the observed relative-strength and lower-path-risk difference persists; MU could reverse it if its guided operating momentum continues and relative price leadership reaccelerates. Neither possibility is established by the historical observations alone.

review_conditions.description: Re-review the conditional NVDA-over-MU preference when the next issuer results or verified policy/supply disclosures arrive. Change the view if MU’s pricing/margin outlook and relative leadership improve enough to offset its observed path risk, or if NVDA’s recurring operating earnings, export access, or East-Asian supply position deteriorates.

agent_report.work_summary: Audited the Director draft’s seven claims against the supplied completed-price panels, issuer disclosures and scenario-grid qualifications. No additional tool-based source reading or arithmetic was performed.
main_conclusions: The draft correctly limits the NVDA preference to conditional 63-session market behavior rather than valuation or policy superiority.
The valuation grids are plainly labeled as hypothetical total-GAAP EPS/P-E sensitivities and do not assert probabilities or fair values.
The draft retains material unquantified export, trade and supply channels and does not treat momentum as sufficient on its own.
agent_report.short_summary: No material claim-specific objection was identified. The draft’s conditional framing is consistent with the independent risk view.
limitations: No new evidence was obtained in this review.
Unquantified policy, supply, geographic-exposure and forward-valuation inputs remain limitations of the underlying draft.
